type_coercion.description: HyperQL uses strict typing with explicit coercion. Implicit type coercion is ONLY allowed for numeric widening (Int -> Float).

functions.name: TO_DECIMAL
functions.signature: TO_DECIMAL(value: Int|Float|String, precision: Int, scale: Int) -> Decimal

null_handling.description: Null propagation follows SQL semantics. v0.19 maintains a null bitmap for O(1) null checks.
rules: Node<T>?: If the referenced child node is deleted, the field value becomes null.
MERGE Semantics: Null values in a MERGE pattern act as wildcards (match any existing value). Existing values are preserved ('kept') when matched against a null, unless explicitly overwritten to null.

enum_semantics.section: 1.11 Enum Backing Values Are Not Arithmetic Operands
enum_semantics.description: Enum backing values — regardless of type — are identity markers, not numeric operands. A backing value is the canonical serialized form and the basis for comparison. It is not a participant in arithmetic. This applies to all typed enum variants (<INT>, <DECIMAL>, <STRING>, <FLAGS>). v0.19 resolves shorthand (.Identifier) to fully qualified variants during the type-checking pass.
rules: VALID: comparison using backing value ordering (WHERE t.Priority >= Priority.HIGH).
INVALID: arithmetic on enum backing values (WHERE price * invoice.Rate > 100). Fails with [2001] Type mismatch.
Extraction: To compute with a backing value (e.g., a rate), extract it via CASE or a lookup table.

enum_flags_shorthand.resolution_rule: .Identifier resolves as an enum/flags constant shorthand (EnumVariantExpr) if and only if the type expected at that position is a known Enum<T> or Flags<T>. v0.19: After type-checking, no .Identifier nodes remain [Decision 11].
enum_flags_shorthand.chained_resolution: In a bitwise OR (|) or AND (&) expression, the type context established by the leftmost operand governs shorthand resolution for all subsequent operands in the chain.

ast_lifecycle.pre_typecheck_node: ShorthandVariantExpr — carries only the bare identifier string (e.g. 'ACTIVE'). Produced by the parser for any .Identifier expression.
ast_lifecycle.post_typecheck_node: EnumVariantExpr — fully qualified, carries the enum type handle and resolved backing value. Produced by the type-checker replacing every ShorthandVariantExpr.
ast_lifecycle.invariant: No ShorthandVariantExpr nodes remain in the AST after the type-checking pass completes. Any that cannot be resolved produce [2021] Unresolvable Enum Shorthand.

enum_flags_shorthand.failure_modes: If type context cannot be uniquely inferred, the engine emits [2021] Unresolvable Enum Shorthand.
examples: SET d.Types = .FIRE | .COLD; /* context established by .FIRE propagates to .COLD */

bitwise_operators.description: Added in v0.19 for FLAGS-typed operands only. Using on non-FLAGS types is error [2001].

operators.name: Bitwise NOT
operators.desc: Inverts all bits in a FLAGS value (unary).

operators.name: FLAGS Containment
operators.desc: True if all bits in left operand are set in right operand.

unit_conversion_recommendation.philosophy: Avoid enums for unit conversion factors (e.g., grams to kilograms). Use a graph-native model for extensibility.
pattern: 1. Define a Unit node type (e.g., MassUnit) with a to_base_factor: Decimal(15, 8) @readonly.
2. Define a @pure UDF (e.g., ConvertMass) for conversion logic.
3. Seed units as nodes; add new units via CREATE NODE without schema migration.
4. Units are queryable entities: MATCH (u:MassUnit) RETURN u.unit_name ORDER BY u.to_base_factor.

expression_language.description: Standard Expression Language for @computed properties and query expressions.

traverse.evaluation: Lazy evaluation with Per-Row Memoization within a QueryPlan context.

cache_behavior.multiple_references: Computed once per row, reused within same query
cache_behavior.example: RETURN p.friend_count, p.friend_count * 2 /* Computed once, used twice */
cache_behavior.with_boundaries: Cache survives WITH clauses if variable is passed through
cache_behavior.example_with: MATCH (p:Person) WITH p, p.friend_count AS fc RETURN fc /* Computed before WITH */
cache_behavior.optional_match: Cache cleared for null-binding rows from OPTIONAL MATCH
cache_behavior.example_optional: OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:Friend]-(f) RETURN p.friend_count /* May execute twice if p has no friends */
cache_behavior.subqueries: Each subquery execution has independent cache
cache_behavior.transaction_boundaries: Cache does NOT survive across separate query executions

traverse.v020_guidance: For production schemas where read performance is critical, use @materialized to move cost to write time. Unmaterialized @computed(TRAVERSE) re-executes per query but still memoizes within a single query execution.

udaf_expression_semantics.description: Expression evaluation within DEFINE AGGREGATE FUNCTION follows clause-specific scope rules.

STATE.description: Initial values must be constants or deterministic pure calls. Graph access is forbidden.

ACCUMULATE.scope: Input parameters, current STATE slot values.
ACCUMULATE.description: Evaluated once per row. Every STATE slot must be assigned exactly once.

FINALIZE.scope: Final STATE slot values only. Input parameters are NOT in scope.
FINALIZE.description: Evaluated once after all rows are processed. Always called exactly once.

null_coalescing.description: Returns right operand if left is null, otherwise returns left
null_coalescing.chaining: Can be chained: p.nickname ?? p.preferred_name ?? p.first_name

safe_navigation.description: Returns null if left operand is null, otherwise accesses property
safe_navigation.example: p.address?.city /* Struct access */, team.lead?.name /* Node<T> access */
safe_navigation.note: Useful for nullable Struct and Node<T> fields

literals.note: The 'd' suffix is required for Decimal literals and <DECIMAL> enum backing values.

built_in_functions.structural_separation: Built-in functions are divided into three formally separate enums: BuiltinFn (Scalar), AggFn (Aggregate), and WindowFn (Window) [Decision 5].

overloading_resolution.ambiguity: If multiple signatures match after coercion, error [2030] Ambiguous function call

examples.resolution: Both arguments must be same type or Int coerced to Float

conditional_expressions.description: v0.20 defines three distinct conditional AST variants.

IfExpr.syntax: IF condition THEN then_expr ELSE else_expr
IfExpr.description: condition must be Bool. else branch is required. Common supertype required for results.

CaseExpr.syntax: CASE [subject] WHEN condition THEN result ... ELSE default END
CaseExpr.description: Supports searched and simple forms. ELSE is required. All results must be compatible.

union_variant_binding.description: For union types, variant patterns may bind fields for use in the result expression.
union_variant_binding.example: MATCH result { Hit { score, node_id } => score * 100.0, Miss => 0.0, _ => null }

MatchExpr.exhaustiveness: Union matches must cover all variants or include a wildcard. Non-exhaustive union match is a definition error [1059].

subquery_expressions.description: Subqueries embedded in expressions as distinct variants.

ExistsExpr.desc: True if subquery produces any rows.

InSubqueryExpr.desc: True if expr matches any value in subquery result (exactly one column required).

scripting_and_control_flow.description: Procedural constructs in DEFINE FUNCTION bodies. Represented as Stmt union variants. v0.19: Purity is statically validated at definition time via transitive call-graph analysis [Decision 12].

purity_validation_algorithm.trigger: Executed at function definition time. If any violation is found, the function definition is rejected and [2054] Purity Violation names the specific violating call site.
steps: 1. Walk the function body AST. Collect all call sites (built-in calls and UDF calls).
2. For each built-in call site: classify as non-pure if the function is NOW(), UUID(), or any built-in that performs I/O. All other BuiltinFn entries are pure.
3. For each UDF call site: look up the callee's declared purity decorator. If the callee's level is less strict than the calling function's declared decorator, emit [2054].
4. Repeat step 3 transitively until no unvisited callees remain. The full transitive closure of the call graph is checked.
5. If any violation is found anywhere in the transitive closure, the function is not stored. The error message names the specific violating call site, not just the top-level function.
purity_validation_algorithm.recursive_note: Recursive and mutually recursive UDFs are permitted. Purity of a recursive function is determined solely by its own body and the purity level of called functions, not by the recursion structure.

ConstDecl.description: Declares an immutable block-scoped variable. Initialized immediately.

WhileStmt.description: condition must be Bool. break/continue are valid.

ForInStmt.description: Iterates over elements in a list or MATCH result.

ReturnStmt.description: Mandatory reachable path required [1051]. Terminates function.

constraint_expression_language.description: Constraints use the standard HyperQL expression language with specific context variables. All constraints must be named.

available_context.this: Reference to the node instance being validated
available_context.field_names: Direct reference to all fields defined in the node
available_context.node_field.child_field: Access fields of child nodes referenced via Node<T>

node_constraints.example: { constraints: { valid_age: age >= 0 AND age <= 150, has_name: name != "", valid_lead: lead.status == AccountStatus.ACTIVE } }
node_constraints.notes: 'this.age' and 'age' are equivalent. Default values are written before constraints are evaluated. A default violating a constraint fails with [3011].

available_context.Type.field: Reference to fields of allowed node types

role_constraints.notes: Roles now carry their full definition inline within DEFINE EDGE.

available_context.role_name: Direct reference to nodes bound to roles

edge_constraints.example: { constraints: { different_people: husband != wife, valid_date: date <= NOW() } }

constraint_evaluation.named_constraints: Object syntax evaluates all constraints and reports all failures. Anonymous constraints are no longer supported.

placement_rules: Valid on named constraints in object form.
FORBIDDEN on role ALLOWS constraint blocks [1060].
evaluation: Evaluation occurs at transaction COMMIT time, not statement time.
Failure at commit time triggers full transaction rollback.
Compatible with ON ERROR CONTINUE (failures recorded in TransactionResult.errors).
